page.layout: One printed page: a single column of dictionary entries, Hebrew, Chaldee and Syriac words with Latin glosses, running from the head to the foot. The page number and running head are at the top, the gathering signature at the foot.

main_text.p: נגע Hinc Pahel Fut. litteris geminatis ואגעגע Et oblectabo me, Psal.119.117.
נף Ch. Claudere, concludere, occludere, Malach.1. 10. Adulterare, adulterari, adulterium committere, quasi corpora miscere, vel prostituere. Aphel אגיף vide in גפף.
גוף, גיפא Ch. Corpus. Plur. גופי, גופין.
גיפא Ch. Adulter. Plur. גיפין. Foemin. גיפתא Adultera.
גיפא Ch. Idem. Plur. constr. גיפי, Psal.50.18.
מגופה, מגופתא Ch. Operculum. Plur. מגופין, מגופתא.
גוץ Ch. Brevis, Curtus, גוין ימין Brevis diebus, Jobi 14.1. Hebr. קצר.
גור Chald. & Syr. Aduiterare, Moechari, Scortari. Ithpah. אתגיר Peregrinari, diversari, commorari: Item Profelytus fieri. Pahel Fut. לא תגיר Ne adulteres, Jobi 36.20.
גיירא גייר גיאר Ch. & Syr. Adulter, Moechus. Plur. Adulteri, Jac.4.4. 1.ad Cor.6.9. Foemin. גיירתא Adultera, Adulterina.
גיורא Ch. Idem: Item Peregrinus, advena, proselytus: Hinc apud LXX. γειώρας Proselytus. Plural. גיורין, גיורייא Adulteri: Proselyti. Foeminin. גיורתא Adultera.
[illegible, ~3 letters] Syr. Advena, proselytus, Act.6.5. Matth.23. 15. Plur. [illegible, ~3 letters] Act.2.11. &13.43.

page.notes: Hebrew, Chaldee and Syriac letters and vowel points are only partly legible on the scan; the Hebrew forms marked as read are best readings, and the Syriac forms opening the last two entries are illegible. The scan is slightly skewed and the entries are hung at the left, so the line-initial words are set as separate paragraphs. The Greek γειώρας is a best reading. Show-through from the reverse page appears faintly in the right margin and is not transcribed.
